definitions.gloss: this world, the present life, the mortal world
definitions.explanation: The world we live in now, as opposed to the afterlife or a spiritual realm. Often used in literary, philosophical, or emotional contexts.

examples.english: Nothing lasts forever in this world.

examples.japanese: この{世|よ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なもの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the most important thing in this world?

examples.japanese: この{世|よ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思う：00492_omou⟧ほど⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧だった。
examples.english: The scenery was so beautiful it seemed out of this world.

notes:
この{世|よ} refers to the present, living world as opposed to the afterlife or a spiritual realm. It carries a literary, philosophical, or emotional tone and is common in proverbs, poetry, and reflective speech.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- この{世|よ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思う：00492_omou⟧: otherworldly, unbelievably beautiful
- この{世|よ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧: the end of the world
- この{世|よ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧: to pass away, to leave this world
- この{世|よ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧: to live in this world
- この{世|よ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: to be born into this world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- この{世|よ}: this world (the living world)
- ⟦あの{世|よ}→あの世：10214_anoyo⟧: the next world (the afterlife)
- ⟦{現世|げんせ}→現世：20421_gense⟧: the present world (Buddhist term, more formal)

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary. In everyday conversation, ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (world) or ⟦{世|よ}の{中|なか}→世の中：03666_yononaka⟧ (society, the world at large) is more common.
